beforePrompt: One photorealistic documentary-style view of an ordinary garage before organization. Fixed camera, natural neutral daylight, realistic worn walls and uncoated concrete, clearly visible doors, windows, tracks and permanent floor markings. Plausible moderate clutter and identifiable useful belongings. No people, private information or customer claims. Use the scene-specific brief.
afterPrompt: Edit the exact before source, preserving its camera, crop, room geometry, architectural features, original finishes and lighting. Remove unwanted packaging and agreed clutter; relocate recognizable useful possessions into practical physically supported storage. Do not duplicate objects, repaint, add epoxy, remodel the room, alter windows or invent luxury cabinetry. Keep access routes clear. Output one photorealistic fictional design concept, not documentary proof of a completed job.

publishContract.badge: AI-generated concept · Not a customer job
requirements: Actual completed output IDs and exact returned media URLs
Visual comparison of both images, not approval inferred from a successful generation
Recorded reviewer, review date and concrete observations

Generated concepts never become actual customer-project evidence, testimonials or invented job prices

automationBoundary: Generation is performed on request through the authorized ChatGPT/Higgsfield connection.
